prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity front-on portrait mobile UI design, approximately 1024x1536. This is a visual candidate for the participation-history section of the WRC running-club mini app. The attached image is a CONTENT AND BRAND REFERENCE, not a layout to copy. Background #fbfcf9, primary pine green #072f27, muted sage metadata, very restrained #d9ff3f accents. Beautiful crisp simplified Chinese system typography, 700 weight headings, 200-300 weight supporting text. Generous aligned margins and controlled whitespace. Preserve the two recognizable challenge poster images (teal December trophy and orange October trophy), plus the crowd group photo and the photo of four runners from the reference. Keep actual content and counts: “挑战”, “80 次”, “团跑”, “201 次”; “2026年12月里程挑战”, “2026年10月里程挑战”, “微网跑团273期聚跑”, “微网跑团272期聚跑”. Dates 2026.12.01, 2026.10.01, 2026.04.22, 2026.04.15. Omit 00:00. No invented progress, distance, rankings, status badges or reward graphics. Remove the current nested card-inside-card appearance, thick rounded boxes, duplicated English labels, awkward letterbox panels and tiny squeezed headings. Fully readable clean text, realistic implementable interface, warm and quiet athletic brand. DESIGN A: AIRY UNBOXED PHOTO ALBUM. Two clean category sections directly on the warm page background. Each header: category left in bold 20px and unobtrusive count plus a thin arrow on the right. Each section has a horizontal gallery showing two generous images, about two columns across. Challenge posters use their natural portrait proportions with the complete poster visible, and no gray letterbox background. Group photos use natural photo proportions, full images visible. Gently rounded image corners only; no border card around image/caption and no outer classification box. Below each image put a well spaced one-or-two-line title and a small light short date. Subtle thin horizontal divider separates categories. Recompose the image dimensions to make the posters more impressive and text airy. Both sections and all four records visible in the composition. This is the simplest, most restrained candidate.
